===== sqlserver/marts.fct_events/load.by_key.sql =====
-- dbdatabuild rendered load operation. Generated by `project compile`; do not edit.
-- model:           marts.fct_events
-- operation:       by_key
-- connection:      sqlserver
-- strategy:        merge_by_key
-- definition hash: f15148c08525742c57b08b6f8ac0a41c89993eeab026ec430b20f32256399de2
-- parameters:      none
SET XACT_ABORT ON;
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #ddb_stage;
BEGIN TRANSACTION;
WITH ddb_body AS (SELECT e.event_id, e.event_ts, e.seq, e.payload FROM staging.events AS e)
SELECT [event_id], [event_ts], [seq], [payload] INTO #ddb_stage FROM ddb_body;
MERGE INTO [marts].[fct_events] AS tgt USING #ddb_stage AS src ON (tgt.[event_id] = src.[event_id])
WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET tgt.[event_ts] = src.[event_ts], tgt.[seq] = src.[seq], tgt.[payload] = src.[payload]
WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ([event_id], [event_ts], [seq], [payload]) VALUES (src.[event_id], src.[event_ts], src.[seq], src.[payload]);
DROP TABLE #ddb_stage;
COMMIT TRANSACTION;

===== sqlserver/marts.fct_events/load.daily.resolve.sql =====
-- dbdatabuild resolver for a rendered load operation. Generated by `project compile`; do not edit.
-- model:           marts.fct_events
-- operation:       daily
-- connection:      sqlserver
-- strategy:        watermark_append
-- definition hash: f15148c08525742c57b08b6f8ac0a41c89993eeab026ec430b20f32256399de2
-- parameters:      @watermark (TIMESTAMP, resolver, overridable)
SELECT COALESCE(DATEADD(HOUR, -6, MAX([event_ts])), CAST('2020-01-01 00:00:00' AS DATETIME2(6))) FROM [marts].[fct_events];

===== sqlserver/marts.fct_events/load.daily.sql =====
-- dbdatabuild rendered load operation. Generated by `project compile`; do not edit.
-- model:           marts.fct_events
-- operation:       daily
-- connection:      sqlserver
-- strategy:        watermark_append
-- definition hash: f15148c08525742c57b08b6f8ac0a41c89993eeab026ec430b20f32256399de2
-- parameters:      @watermark (TIMESTAMP, resolver, overridable)
SET XACT_ABORT ON;
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #ddb_stage;
BEGIN TRANSACTION;
WITH ddb_body AS (SELECT e.event_id, e.event_ts, e.seq, e.payload FROM staging.events AS e)
SELECT [event_id], [event_ts], [seq], [payload] INTO #ddb_stage FROM ddb_body WHERE ddb_body.[event_ts] >= @watermark;
DELETE FROM [marts].[fct_events] WHERE [event_ts] >= @watermark;
INSERT INTO [marts].[fct_events] ([event_id], [event_ts], [seq], [payload])
SELECT [event_id], [event_ts], [seq], [payload] FROM #ddb_stage;
DROP TABLE #ddb_stage;
COMMIT TRANSACTION;

===== sqlserver/marts.fct_events/load.reload_period.sql =====
-- dbdatabuild rendered load operation. Generated by `project compile`; do not edit.
-- model:           marts.fct_events
-- operation:       reload_period
-- connection:      sqlserver
-- strategy:        delete_insert_by_range
-- definition hash: f15148c08525742c57b08b6f8ac0a41c89993eeab026ec430b20f32256399de2
-- parameters:      @start (TIMESTAMP, runtime), @end (TIMESTAMP, runtime, max_span 400 days)
SET XACT_ABORT ON;
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #ddb_stage;
BEGIN TRANSACTION;
WITH ddb_body AS (SELECT e.event_id, e.event_ts, e.seq, e.payload FROM staging.events AS e)
SELECT [event_id], [event_ts], [seq], [payload] INTO #ddb_stage FROM ddb_body WHERE ddb_body.[event_ts] >= @start AND ddb_body.[event_ts] < @end;
DELETE FROM [marts].[fct_events] WHERE [event_ts] >= @start AND [event_ts] < @end;
INSERT INTO [marts].[fct_events] ([event_id], [event_ts], [seq], [payload])
SELECT [event_id], [event_ts], [seq], [payload] FROM #ddb_stage;
DROP TABLE #ddb_stage;
COMMIT TRANSACTION;
